notes.title: 0915 Patch: Update for 16:10 resolution users!
notes.notes:
I've corrected the overlapping of the item window and the arrow to the right. Now that I've pulled the arrow a little more inside the screen, it won't overlap anymore. It can now proceed normally.



16:9 resolution users may find it a little awkward to have arrows gathered in the middle, but please still play it as it is. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557092/8474bb4fc47f40b0d36eeface4ed69e17d9da3fa.png"]



If the update doesn't apply, please log out the steam and log in and update it. 

Thank you!
